playwright_config.note: Must scroll down 300px before capturing Bug #1 and #2 to reveal positioning and z-index failures.

bugs.report_text: The overlay layer scrolls with the page content instead of remaining anchored to the screen viewport, causing layout elements to shift unexpectedly during scrolling.
The navigation bar is obscured by scrolling content below it, making menu items inaccessible and breaking the intended visual hierarchy.

bugs.pos_code: <nav className="backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/50 border-b border-slate-700/50 sticky top-0">

bugs.report_text: The main heading displays in abnormally small text compared to intended design, breaking the visual hierarchy and reducing emphasis on the hero section.
bugs.neg_code: <h1 className="text-6xl md:text-7xl font-bold mb-6 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-400 via-pink-400 to-blue-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
bugs.pos_code: <h1 className="text-6x md:text-7xl font-bold mb-6 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-400 via-pink-400 to-blue-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent">

bugs.report_text: The button loses its gradient color effect and appears in a flat, plain appearance, reducing visual appeal and button prominence.
bugs.neg_code: <button className="px-8 py-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-pink-600 rounded-lg hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-purple-500/50 transition transform hover:scale-105 font-semibold">

bugs.report_text: The statistics section remains cramped in a single column layout on desktop screens instead of expanding into a balanced 4-column grid.
The statistics labels are nearly invisible against the dark background, making them difficult to read and destroying readability.
The project cards are arranged horizontally in a single row and extend beyond the visible viewport, making them impossible to view without horizontal scrolling.
